pattern_families.label: Standard 7-column genealogy table with separate summary
pattern_families.description: Chapters with a main genealogy table using the header NAME|BORN|MARRIED|SPOUSE|BOY|GIRL|DIED, separate summary/total table, single non-concatenated subgroup/context rows, and no fused BOY/GIRL columns.
allowed_variants: Multiple genealogy tables only if each is a legitimate family group, not fragmentation
Summary/total table may be present as a separate table

document_local_conventions.subgroup_context_rows: Single, non-concatenated context rows for each subgroup/family
document_local_conventions.table_fragmentation: No fragmentation; one genealogy table per family group, summary table separate
document_local_conventions.summary_rows: Summary/total rows are in a separate table, not appended to the main genealogy table
document_local_conventions.marginal_or_handwritten_notes: Notes must be placed in the correct semantic column (child events in BOY/GIRL, death events in DIED); unclassified notes require further evidence
